result:
Round 203 passes. Every acceptance row that can run here passed in a real browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. Each row was run on A's tree and on a copy of the round's start state (the reference), and the reference still shows both round-202 failures.

| Row | Result | What I measured |
|---|---|---|
| SCOPE-203 | PASS | All 1030 locked files are unchanged at the start and the end. The tree has 32 modified and 5 new files. Each changed file contains only its R101–R104 change. The 4 protected files, `.claude` and `CLAUDE.md` are unchanged. |
| ERROR-BORDER-203 | PASS | Six fields: Sign In email and password, Sign Up name, email and password, and Forgot password email. After an empty submit each has a red border `rgb(210,119,106)` and `aria-invalid="true"`. The red holds when unfocused, Tab-focused (brass outline, no shadow) and mouse-focused. Contrast against the field background is 5.76:1. The reference stays grey (3.50:1). The `/support` guest form is the same on both. `/hire-us` does not use `ui/Input`. |
| CONTRAST-203 | PASS | Measured per side at 3× pixel density. Product page, top / bottom / left / right (gap / out): 3.21/3.35, 5.14/1.54, 4.58/4.70, 5.38/5.41. Bottom passes on gap; the 1.54 is the cover art next to the ring. The `/` card is ≥ 3.97 on every side. The reference reproduces the old top 2.39/2.68. At 1× density the product top is 2.89/3.17, still a pass. |
| HOVER-203 | PASS | Hover scales to 1.1 on both, and the hover shadow is now dark instead of teal. After a mouse click there is no ring. |
| TYPING-203 | PASS | Six fields: store search, newsletter, sign-in email, the ⌘K box (opened by mouse), Studio library search and the Studio tempo field. After a click, typing, Shift+letter, caret keys, Backspace/Delete and a held key show no ring. The reference shows a ring from the first typed key. Escape, ArrowDown and Tab switch to keyboard mode. In the Studio library search, ArrowDown moves focus to the first result with the ring. A field reached with Tab keeps its ring while you type. |
| NONTEXT-203 | PASS | Master Volume, Pan and a store button behave exactly as in the reference. |
| KEY-RING-203 | PASS | Tab sweep of `/store`, the product page and the sign-in dialog (both tabs) matches round 202. The only difference is the Play preview shadow colour. |
| NO-SHIFT-203 | PASS | No element moved, in 6 page states × 2 viewports. |
| T-RUN-203 | PASS, with two noted deviations | Tests ran on scratch copies. A's mutants each turn their test red, except n1, which stays green by design. Three of my own mutants also turn red. |
| Final checks | PASS | Code-quality review of the added lines: no `any`, `as`, `@ts-ignore` or hex colours. Logged-out check: the demo opens, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required", and `/api/studio-token` returns 401 without a token and 403 with a fake one. The premium sign-in is not bypassed. |
| `account/reset` and `/studio/:id` | BLOCKED | Need the backend, which isn't available here. |

The two T-RUN deviations, which root should see:
- **Mutant left green.** My mutant that puts the old red-border class back in `Textarea` only stays green. It is the same kind as A's n1: these tests are not allowed to check styling classes, and no page renders `Textarea`, so no browser check can catch it. I filed it as C-R203-01 instead of failing the row.
- **Table line can't happen.** The task table expects "new STF2 cases red" on the start copy. That cannot happen: STF2 scans the real source, and the start source has nothing for it to flag. It only goes red with a mutant (n8 and my c4 do). The new STF5 examples, run against the old scanner, are red as intended.

New findings, both Low, for the deferred polish list:
- **C-R203-01:** the `Textarea` error border has no test or browser coverage. Nothing uses `Textarea` today.
- **C-R203-02 (already in the reference):** pressing Escape in the ⌘K box or the sign-in dialog leaves focus on the page body instead of returning it to the button that opened it. The sign-in dialog part is the known `shared-modal-no-focus-management`; I found no existing entry for the ⌘K box.

Not verified, for B to decide:
- **Android keyboards and AltGr/Option characters still bring the ring back mid-typing.** This is A's reviewer item M1: Android soft keyboards and IME composition send keys the new check doesn't recognise, and AltGr/Option characters such as `@` on German layouts count as shortcuts. I couldn't test this without an Android device.
- **Accessibility reviewer's view.** It rated the "only the text cursor shows after a click" trade-off, M1 and AltGr as low risk. It suggested `outline-color: transparent` instead of `outline: none` for mouse focus, so the ring survives Windows high-contrast mode. That comes from round 202's design, not this round.
- **A skipped a STOP rule.** A carried on past a literal step-2 STOP: its search hit two locked Studio tests that are unrelated to `ui/Input`. Both pass here.

I did not run the full test suite, typecheck, build or `npm run verify`; those are left to root's gate. Ableton comparison doesn't apply to store pages. My reference server and the mock server are stopped; the main dev server on :5173 is still running.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- `c-round-203.md`
- `c-round-203.json`
- `c-round-203/` (tools, measurements, screenshots, scratch test copies)
